parameters.query: SELECT * FROM backlink_candidates WHERE id::text = $1 AND review_token = $2 LIMIT 1;

UPDATE backlink_candidates
SET status = CASE
      WHEN $3 = 'reject' THEN 'rejected'
      WHEN platform = 'bluesky' THEN 'approved'
      ELSE 'manual'
    END,
    answer = CASE WHEN $3 = 'reject' THEN answer ELSE $4 END,
    reviewed_at = now()
WHERE id::text = $1
  AND review_token = $2
  AND status = 'pending_review'
  AND $3 IN ('approve', 'reject')
  AND ($3 = 'reject' OR length(trim($4)) > 0)
RETURNING *;

UPDATE backlink_candidates
SET status = 'posted', posted_url = $2, posted_at = now()
WHERE id::text = $1
RETURNING *;

UPDATE backlink_candidates
SET status = 'failed', error_message = $2
WHERE id::text = $1
RETURNING *;

UPDATE backlink_candidates
SET status = 'posted', posted_at = now()
WHERE id::text = $1 AND review_token = $2 AND status = 'manual'
RETURNING *;
